title: Document Ownership
content: Document ownership is assigned from the authenticated user. The public document creation payload does not choose owner_id. Authorization uses ownership to decide which documents and chunks the authenticated user may access.

title: Database Migrations
content: The Mission Knowledge Assistant uses Alembic to version and apply PostgreSQL schema migrations. The migration history is kept in source control so database structure changes can be reproduced.

title: RAG Answerability and Abstention
content: Retrieval success does not automatically mean a question is answerable. If authorized evidence is absent or semantic evaluation does not permit generation, the RAG pipeline abstains instead of generating an unsupported answer.

title: Secondary User Confidential Notes
content: The confidential launch code is ORBIT-731. The secondary user's private provider token label is SECONDARY-TOKEN. This document belongs only to the secondary evaluation user and must never be retrieved for the primary user.
